sentences.text: Shakajlura is an extinct genus known only from a single species, recognized by a partial skull and fragmentary skeleton.
Ariel F. Cardillo and colleagues formally described Shakajlura riojanensis as a new genus and species in 2026.
Shakajlura is considered a new component among the top predators of the Chañares Formation.
Shakajlura is probably an early-diverging member of the clade Paracrocodylomorpha, though researchers note that its placement as an early-diverging loricid cannot be discarded.
This animal lived during the Ladinian to Carnian ages of the Triassic period, estimated between 241.464 and 227.3 million years ago.
Fossils were discovered in the Tarjadia Assemblage Zone of the Chañares Formation in La Rioja Province, northwestern Argentina.
